service.description: Extract HotWax OMS orders for an automation window and write normalized JSON output to the automation data-manager folder.

parameter.name: omsRestSourceConfigId
parameter.description: Tenant-owned HotWaxOmsRestSourceConfig identifier.

parameter.name: automationExecutionId
parameter.description: Automation execution id used to choose the default data-manager output folder.

parameter.name: companyUserGroupId
parameter.description: Trusted automation owner tenant. When present, config access is checked against this tenant instead of a user-session active tenant.

parameter.name: windowStart
parameter.description: Start of the automation window; accepts Timestamp, Date, ISO-8601 text, SQL timestamp text, or epoch milliseconds.

parameter.name: windowEnd
parameter.description: End of the automation window; accepts Timestamp, Date, ISO-8601 text, SQL timestamp text, or epoch milliseconds.

parameter.name: outputLocation
parameter.description: Optional output directory. Defaults to runtime://datamanager/reconciliation-runs/{automationExecutionId}/{timestamp}/.

parameter.name: fileName
parameter.description: Optional output file name. Defaults to oms-orders-{fromMillis}-{thruMillis}.json.

parameter.name: keepRecordFields
parameter.description: Optional projection: top-level record fields to keep in the output file. When present, each order is trimmed to these fields after reconciliation filtering and before writing (callers compute the list from the rule set's join-key and rule fields plus the display fields). Absent means full untrimmed records (backward compatible).

parameter.name: sourceFilters
parameter.description: Optional record-exclusion rules. Each rule names a top-level record field and a comma-separated list of exact values; matching orders are dropped before the extract file is written and counted per rule in requestMetadata.filters.configuredExclusions. Absent or empty means no configured exclusions (backward compatible).

parameter.name: reconciliationRunResultId
parameter.description: Optional observability run id. On its own it is enough for the extractor to heartbeat a running order count onto the run's RUNNING extract step as pages are consumed, so the live view can show the count climbing. Advisory only.

parameter.name: progressStageCode
parameter.description: Which extract stage this run is: EXTRACT_FILE1 or EXTRACT_FILE2. Required for progress to land, because the heartbeat targets the RUNNING step for this stage and the same extractor runs on either side depending on the saved run's source order. Defaults to EXTRACT_FILE2 for callers that predate this parameter.

parameter.name: expectedRecordCount
parameter.description: Optional expected total, which adds a progress percent alongside the count — typically the other side's extracted record count for the same window. Only the second extract of a run can supply one; the first has nothing finished to divide against.

parameter.name: exchangeManifestFileLocation
parameter.description: Location of the exchange-manifest sidecar written when the window contained excluded exchange orders; null otherwise. Identities/amounts only, capped at 500 entries.

service.description:
Extract HotWax OMS orders for an automation window from the purpose-built /rest/s1/oms/reconciliationOrders endpoint, writing normalized JSON output to the automation data-manager folder. Same in/out contract and same on-disk file shape as extract#HotWaxOmsOrders, so the automation edge and the Spark compare stage are unchanged; the endpoint differs in that it filters to comparison-eligible sales orders server-side, projects to a fixed field set, honours pageSize, and reports hasMore/ordersCount instead of leaving termination to be inferred.
A distinct service name from extract#HotWaxOmsOrders is required because the connector registry resolves a connector row by its extract service name. Adoption is opt-in: a rule set moves to this connector by pointing its source at sourceConfigType HOTWAX_OMS_REST_RECON, against the same HotWaxOmsRestSourceConfig row.
GATING: the endpoint returns a fixed field set, so before enabling this connector for a rule set, verify that rule set's join key and every field-comparison field fall inside {orderId, externalId, orderName, grandTotal, orderDate, statusId}. A rule set needing any other field must stay on extract#HotWaxOmsOrders.

parameter.name: omsRestSourceConfigId
parameter.description: Tenant-owned HotWaxOmsRestSourceConfig identifier. Reuses the same OMS credentials and baseUrl as sales-order extraction; only the path differs, and the path is fixed by the extractor rather than read from the config's ordersPath.

parameter.name: automationExecutionId
parameter.description: Automation execution id used to choose the default data-manager output folder.

parameter.name: companyUserGroupId
parameter.description: Trusted automation owner tenant. When present, config access is checked against this tenant instead of a user-session active tenant.

parameter.name: windowStart
parameter.description: Start of the automation window; accepts Timestamp, Date, ISO-8601 text, SQL timestamp text, or epoch milliseconds. Sent as the half-open lower bound orderDateFrom.

parameter.name: windowEnd
parameter.description: End of the automation window, same accepted formats as windowStart. Sent as orderDateThru, which the endpoint treats as EXCLUSIVE — an order timestamped exactly at the bound belongs to the next window, so consecutive chunks do not double-count their boundary.

parameter.name: outputLocation
parameter.description: Optional output directory. Defaults to runtime://datamanager/reconciliation-runs/{automationExecutionId}/{timestamp}/.

parameter.name: fileName
parameter.description: Optional output file name. Defaults to oms-orders-{fromMillis}-{thruMillis}.json, matching the legacy extractor so saved-run file-side matching is unaffected.

parameter.name: keepRecordFields
parameter.description: Optional projection: top-level record fields to keep in the output file. Normally a no-op here because the endpoint already projects server-side; retained so the parameter contract matches extract#HotWaxOmsOrders and so a caller asking for a narrower set than the endpoint's still gets it.

parameter.name: sourceFilters
parameter.description: Optional record-exclusion rules, same semantics as extract#HotWaxOmsOrders. These stay client-side on this connector too: the endpoint has no knowledge of tenant exclusion rules, so matching runs in the extractor before output.

parameter.name: reconciliationRunResultId
parameter.description: Optional observability run id for progress heartbeats. Advisory only.

parameter.name: progressStageCode
parameter.description: Which extract stage this run is: EXTRACT_FILE1 or EXTRACT_FILE2. Defaults to EXTRACT_FILE2.

parameter.name: expectedRecordCount
parameter.description: Optional expected total, which adds a progress percent alongside the count.

parameter.name: exchangeManifestFileLocation
parameter.description: Location of the exchange-manifest sidecar written when the window contained exchange orders; null otherwise. Same shape and same 500-entry cap as the legacy extractor, but built from the endpoint's inline originalOrderId / originalExternalId fields, so it costs no pair-lookup round-trips.

service.description:
Extract HotWax OMS returns for an automation window from /rest/s1/oms/reconciliationReturns, writing normalized JSON output to the automation data-manager folder (DAR-BE-018).
New capability — Darpan did not reconcile returns before this service, so there is no legacy path to preserve. Same {records, metadata} on-disk contract and the same automation-edge in/out parameters as the orders extractors, so the automation executor, progress heartbeat and Spark compare stage are unchanged.
Lines arrive nested inside their header as items[] and are written through nested (RQ-21); do not flatten. The endpoint pre-excludes returns with no Shopify reference server-side and reports that as excludedNoShopifyRefCount; tenant-configured exclusions (typically on returnChannelEnumId) still run client-side here, on the population that survives.

parameter.name: omsRestSourceConfigId
parameter.description: Tenant-owned HotWaxOmsRestSourceConfig identifier. Reuses the same OMS credentials and baseUrl as order extraction; the returns path is pinned by the extractor.

parameter.name: automationExecutionId
parameter.description: Automation execution id used to choose the default data-manager output folder.

parameter.name: companyUserGroupId
parameter.description: Trusted automation owner tenant. When present, config access is checked against this tenant instead of a user-session active tenant.

parameter.name: windowStart
parameter.description: Start of the automation window; accepts Timestamp, Date, ISO-8601 text, SQL timestamp text, or epoch milliseconds. Sent as the half-open lower bound returnDateFrom, which filters on ReturnHeader.entryDate (RQ-22).

parameter.name: windowEnd
parameter.description: End of the automation window, same accepted formats. Sent as returnDateThru, which the endpoint treats as EXCLUSIVE, so consecutive chunks do not double-count their boundary.

parameter.name: outputLocation
parameter.description: Optional output directory. Defaults to runtime://datamanager/reconciliation-runs/{automationExecutionId}/{timestamp}/.

parameter.name: fileName
parameter.description: Optional output file name. Defaults to oms-returns-{fromMillis}-{thruMillis}.json.

parameter.name: keepRecordFields
parameter.description: Optional projection of top-level record fields. items[] is always retained regardless of this list, because the nested-line contract (RQ-21) does not survive a projection that names only header fields.

parameter.name: sourceFilters
parameter.description: Optional record-exclusion rules, same semantics as the order extractors. These run client-side: the endpoint has no knowledge of tenant exclusion rules. The expected rule here excludes returns whose returnChannelEnumId never has a Shopify counterpart.

parameter.name: reconciliationRunResultId
parameter.description: Optional observability run id for progress heartbeats. Advisory only.

parameter.name: progressStageCode
parameter.description: Which extract stage this run is: EXTRACT_FILE1 or EXTRACT_FILE2. Defaults to EXTRACT_FILE2.

parameter.name: expectedRecordCount
parameter.description: Optional expected total, which adds a progress percent alongside the count.

service.description: Extract HotWax OMS transfer orders (orderTypeId=TRANSFER_ORDER) by date window and/or status, writing normalized JSON output to the automation data-manager folder. Served by the same /rest/s1/oms/orders endpoint as sales orders; the order type is a server-side query filter. A distinct service name from extract#HotWaxOmsOrders is required because the connector registry resolves a connector row by its extract service name.

parameter.name: omsRestSourceConfigId
parameter.description: Tenant-owned HotWaxOmsRestSourceConfig identifier. Transfer-order extraction reuses the same OMS credentials as sales-order extraction.

parameter.name: automationExecutionId
parameter.description: Automation execution id used to choose the default data-manager output folder.

parameter.name: companyUserGroupId
parameter.description: Trusted automation owner tenant. When present, config access is checked against this tenant instead of a user-session active tenant.

parameter.name: windowStart
windowEnd
parameter.description: Optional end of the extract window, same accepted formats as windowStart.

parameter.name: windowFieldName
parameter.description: OrderHeader date field the window filters on. Defaults to orderDate. A transfer order's life spans create to receive, so a deployment that needs long-lived transfers to stay visible can point this at lastUpdatedTxStamp instead.

parameter.name: orderStatusIds
parameter.description: Optional statuses to include, sent to the OMS as a server-side IN filter. Required when no date window is supplied.

parameter.name: outputLocation
parameter.description: Optional output directory. Defaults to runtime://datamanager/reconciliation-runs/{automationExecutionId}/{timestamp}/.

parameter.name: fileName
parameter.description: Optional output file name.

parameter.name: keepRecordFields
parameter.description: Optional projection: top-level record fields to keep in the output file.

parameter.name: sourceFilters
parameter.description: Optional record-exclusion rules, same semantics as extract#HotWaxOmsOrders.

parameter.name: reconciliationRunResultId
parameter.description: Optional observability run id for progress heartbeats. Advisory only.

parameter.name: progressStageCode
parameter.description: Which extract stage this run is: EXTRACT_FILE1 or EXTRACT_FILE2.

parameter.name: expectedRecordCount
parameter.description: Optional expected total, which adds a progress percent alongside the count.

service.description: Point lookup of OMS order groups by Shopify externalId for the exchange pair verify stage. Escapes run windows via a wide orderDate window. A failed lookup returns ok=false with an empty map — it never classifies anything.

parameter.name: companyUserGroupId
parameter.description: Trusted run owner tenant; when present, config access is checked against it instead of a user-session active tenant.
